CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_person_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id from persons where email = auth.jwt() ->> 'email' limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin(choir uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from choir_memberships
    where choir_id = choir
      and person_id = current_person_id()
      and (
        roles @> array['chairman']::text[]
        or roles @> array['conductor']::text[]
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_member(choir uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from choir_memberships
    where choir_id = choir
      and person_id = current_person_id()
  );
$function$
